newsitem.title: POLAND: Investors bid for PLN 4.66 bln of Polish T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Investors bid for PLN 4.66 bln of Polish T-bills.

text.p: Investors bid for 4.66 billion zlotys worth of Polish T-bills at Monday's primary tender against a 1.3 billion zloty offer, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said demand was highest for the 52-week paper totalling 2.58 billion zlotys against a 600 million zloty offer.
Bids for the 26-week paper totalled 692 million zlotys against a 200 million offer, while demand for the 13-week bills was 606 million against a 300 million offer.
Demand for the shortest 8-week bills was 775 million zlotys against a 200 million zloty offer.
Full results of the tender will be available later today.
